title: Attack on Titan
premise: Humanity survives behind three concentric walls. Titans roam the land beyond. The truth about this world is worse than anyone knows.

lore.title: Wall Maria
lore.text: The outermost of three concentric walls, fifty meters high, raised by Eldian ancestors to hold back the Titans. Its gate was breached in the Fall of Shiganshina, and the land behind it was lost.

lore.title: Wall Rose
lore.text: The middle wall, standing behind Wall Maria. The Battle of Trost was fought at its southern gate, where a breach nearly let Titans pour into the inner districts. The walls now define how humanity lives.

lore.title: Wall Sina
lore.text: The innermost wall, home to the royal government and nobility. Its districts are kept clean and quiet while the rest of humanity lives in the shadow of the walls. Military Police guard its gates and its secrets run deep.

lore.title: Shiganshina District
lore.text: A farming district at the edge of Wall Maria and the first place the Colossal Titan breached. Its families were devoured in the attack, and its outer farms were abandoned after the walls fell.

lore.title: Survey Corps
lore.text: The military branch that scouts beyond the walls on horseback with ODM gear. Expeditions are costly and funding is scarce, and public opinion of the Corps is mixed. Commander Erwin Smith leads it.

lore.title: Garrison Regiment
lore.text: The military branch that guards the walls, inner districts and trade routes. Its soldiers rarely meet Titans and sleep behind stone, so many civilians see it as the safe choice for those who cannot face the open land.

lore.title: Military Police Brigade
lore.text: The elite branch that protects the royal government inside Wall Sina. Its members enjoy the best food, housing and pay, and they answer to the king's orders. They hunt traitors and enforce the rules that keep the walls quiet.

lore.title: Marley
lore.text: A distant nation across the sea that rules the Eldian diaspora with an iron hand. Its Warriors program sends Eldian children abroad to fight as soldiers, and Marley fears the Eldian bloodline it holds captive.

lore.title: Eldians
lore.text: An ancient people whose bloodline carries the power to transform into Titans. Marley hunts and enslaves them abroad, and behind the walls their true history is hidden from the people who carry it.

lore.title: Titans
lore.text: Giant humanoid creatures that devour humans and cannot be reasoned with. They come in many sizes, from fifteen-meter types to the Colossal and Armored Titans. Most are mindless, but some watch and hunt with purpose.

lore.title: ODM Gear
lore.text: Omni-Directional Mobility gear. Compressed gas launches anchored grapple hooks so the wearer can swing through the air and cut Titan napes with blades. Gas runs out quickly, so every flight is a countdown to the ground.

lore.title: Nape Weakness and Shifters
lore.text: Titans must be killed by cutting the nape, the only spot where the human inside can be reached. Shifters transform by drawing on Titan power from the Eldian bloodline, and a downed Titan may still hold a living person.

lore.title: Founding Titan
lore.text: The Titan that holds power over all other Titans. Whoever inherits it can command the Titans of the Eldian bloodline. Its line has been hidden inside the royal family for generations, and its power shapes the fate of the walls.

lore.title: Eren Yeager
lore.text: A Shiganshina native who watched his mother die to a Titan and swore to kill every one of them. He joined the Survey Corps and carries a Titan power that few are willing to examine closely. His rage drives the fight against the walls.

lore.title: Mikasa Ackerman
lore.text: A Survey Corps soldier from the Ackerman bloodline, widely considered the most skilled fighter in her ranks. She fights with a blade and ODM gear, and her loyalty to Eren defines nearly every choice she makes.

lore.title: Levi Ackerman
lore.text: Humanity's strongest soldier, a former underground fighter who rose to captain in the Survey Corps. He is ruthless, precise and rarely shows fear. He has led the most dangerous missions and buried many subordinates lost to Titans.

lore.title: Erwin Smith
lore.text: Commander of the Survey Corps who spends soldiers for the long game. He believes the world beyond the walls can be understood and that humanity must push outward. His strategy has cost lives, and his ambition drives the Corps toward terrible choices.

lore.title: Armin Arlert
lore.text: A Survey Corps strategist from Shiganshina who relies on careful thinking and knowledge of the Titans. He is weak in combat but sharp in planning, and he grew up alongside Eren and Mikasa.

lore.title: Hange Zoe
lore.text: A Survey Corps squad leader obsessed with studying Titans. She dissects, observes and experiments in the field, and her curiosity has revealed critical details about how Titans behave.

lore.title: Reiner Braun
lore.text: A Survey Corps soldier who hides his true allegiance behind a loyal face. He is a hardened armored fighter, and his commitment to his comrades is real, but the cause he serves is far darker.
